ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 65:35 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/mottled pixels; high-intensity regions are concentrated on the lateral lobes and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches dominate the outer lateral margins of both lobes, transitioning into a solid low-intensity black central region surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel-calculated angle of 130 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with high-amplitude serrations and peaks, particularly prominent on the superior margin of the right lobe and the distal tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve transitioning from proximal convexity near the notch to distal concavity towards the lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely distributed clusters of circular white rings (ranging 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across the black central regions of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct high-contrast linear vertical disruption visible on the lower-left quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring consistent with barnacle attachment sites across the entire ventral surface and a singular prominent linear rake mark on the left lobe.
